description: This file implements the RialtoConnector class, which manages application sessions and state transitions within the Rialto framework, including initialization, session creation, suspension, resumption, deactivation, and state change notifications.

classes.name: RialtoConnector
classes.description: A class managing application sessions and state within the Rialto framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoConnector, setting up configuration and server management service.

methods.name: createAppSession
methods.description: Creates a new application session with specified callsign, display name, and app ID.

methods.name: resumeSession
methods.description: Resumes a session if it is currently inactive.

methods.name: getCurrentAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the application identified by callsign.

methods.name: deactivateSession
methods.description: Deactivates a session, setting its state to NOT_RUNNING.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for applications.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits for a specific state change for an application within a timeout period.
